turns.replyText:
Today
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m so sorry one of your items didn’t arrive in good shape; I know that’s really disappointing after waiting for your order.
Let’s get this in front of the team so they can review it and help with next steps. Please reply with everything below in one message if you can:
Your full name
The email address you used to place the order
Your order number (if you have it handy)
The name(s) of the damaged item(s)
A few clear photos:
The damaged plant or product
The pot/packaging around it
The outside of the shipping box, including any visible damage and the shipping label
If you’re not able to provide photos, just let me know that as well and we’ll still have the team review your situation.
Once you send that information, I have routed you to one of my colleagues, who will be happy to assist. Be on the lookout for an email from them soon!
